sentences.text: Nogusunna is an extinct genus of anatid, a group of waterfowl related to ducks and geese.
The genus was described by Zelenkov in 2011 based on fossils found at the Sharga fossil site in Mongolia.
Scientists have recorded only one fossil occurrence of this species to date.
This animal lived during the Middle Miocene epoch, specifically between 13.82 and 11.63 million years ago.
